name: HaPijamot in the Dovale Show
overview:
HaPijamot in the Dovaleh Show (HaPijamot BeMofah Shel Dovaleh) was a children's sitcom and a sequel series to HaPijamot in Café Kar Sol. Both of these series are based on the original show, HaPijamot.

In this version, the characters receive a talk show titled "The Dovaleh Show." Dovaleh (played by Kobi Farag) is the host of the program and the manager of the filming studio. Dovaleh is portrayed as an impulsive person.
